summary.headline: Godrej Agrovet Q1 FY27 consolidated sales rose 10% to INR2,852 crore; Crop Care fell 16.2% on delayed monsoon, while management still targets double-digit FY27 PBT growth.
summary.overview: Consolidated sales grew 10% YoY to INR2,852 crore despite a delayed monsoon and geopolitical-driven inflation. Animal Nutrition (revenue +12.6%, reported segment result +29%) and Oil Palm (revenue +28.9%, segment result +14.4%) carried the quarter. Crop Care revenue fell 16.2% on a dry June and slower kharif sowing, and Dairy margins were squeezed by milk procurement costs and packaging inflation. Astec reached EBITDA breakeven versus an INR11 crore loss a year ago. Management reiterated FY27 double-digit consolidated PBT growth (versus earlier mid-teens guidance) but deferred a firmer view on Crop Care until end-September.

Segment result +14.4%; EBIT margin ~17% vs 19% a year ago (per analyst)
vs EBITDA loss of INR11 crore in Q1 FY26
Value-added share of sales 49% vs 42% a year ago

segments.name: Animal Nutrition
segments.commentary: Revenue +12.6% on robust demand and better realisations; cattle feed volume +15% and overall segment volume +7%. Poultry volumes deliberately reduced in unprofitable geographies. Cattle feed is about 55-56% of the segment; fish feed about 7%.

segments.name: Oil Palm
segments.commentary: Revenue +28.9% on higher CPO and PKO realisations and volume; FFB volumes broadly flat versus a strong early-monsoon base. Segment result +14.4%, with margin down on a pricing-formula effect that management calls one-off.

segments.name: Crop Care
segments.commentary: Revenue -16.2% as a dry June and slow kharif sowing hit cotton herbicide volumes, with margin contraction. Ashitaka and Takai together contribute about 18-20% of Q1 sales; Ghassnash soybean herbicide launched.

segments.name: Astec LifeSciences
segments.commentary: EBITDA breakeven versus an INR11 crore loss a year ago; revenue moderately lower on product mix. Management guides FY27 revenue growth of more than 20%, with an 8-9% Q1 dip to be recovered; CDMO dissilience around 50-52%.

segments.name: Dairy (CDPL)
segments.commentary: Revenue +11.4% and volume +8%, but profitability hit by elevated milk procurement prices and packaging inflation. Route-to-market reconstitution (about 18-20 months) under new CEO Gaurav is starting.

segments.name: Godrej Foods
segments.commentary: Revenue broadly stable as live bird trading is planned to fall 15-20% a year and go near zero over 3-4 years. Branded B2C (Yummiez, Real Good) volume +28% and about 32% of the Foods business; profitability hit by input costs.

segments.name: Bangladesh JV (ACI Godrej Agrovet)
segments.commentary: Returned to growth, with double-digit growth in volume, revenue and PBT.
